BiblicalUsage: Kerith is the brook where God hid Elijah from Ahab. 1 Kings 17:3 says, hide thyself by the brook Cherith, that is before Jordan. 1 Kings 17:5 says Elijah went and did according unto the word of the LORD, and dwelt by the brook Cherith.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the brook is God's hiding place: the ravens brought bread there, and the prophet learned that God feeds his own in the wilderness.
